feat-material.name: Waste stream
feat-material.question: Which waste stream is it?
feat-material.description: The material in the container. WasteQuote suggests it from a photo.
feat-material.longDescription:
## Waste stream
The vision step in WasteQuote suggests the stream from a photo; the salesperson confirms it.

variants.name: Cardboard & paper
variants.description: For example boxes, flattened packaging, office paper. EWC 15 01 01, 20 01 01.
variants.longDescription:
## Cardboard & paper
For example boxes, flattened packaging, office paper.

- EWC codes: 15 01 01, 20 01 01
- Low contamination: Clean, dry boxes and paper; under 5% other material.
- Medium contamination: Some tape, labels, film or damp patches; 5-15% other material.
- High contamination: Wet, food-soiled or mixed with general waste; over 15% other material.

variants.name: Clean wood
variants.description: For example pallets, untreated offcuts, crates. EWC 15 01 03, 17 02 01, 03 01 05.
variants.longDescription:
## Clean wood
For example pallets, untreated offcuts, crates.

- EWC codes: 15 01 03, 17 02 01, 03 01 05
- Low contamination: Untreated, unpainted solid wood and pallets; intact pieces.
- Medium contamination: Nails, screws, some chipboard or broken pallets; little else.
- High contamination: Painted, treated, laminated or mixed with other waste.

variants.name: Mixed construction waste
variants.description: For example rubble, timber, plasterboard, packaging from a site. EWC 17 09 04.
variants.longDescription:
## Mixed construction waste
For example rubble, timber, plasterboard, packaging from a site.

- EWC codes: 17 09 04
- Low contamination: Mostly inert (concrete, brick, tile) with some timber and metal.
- Medium contamination: Inert plus plasterboard, plastics, insulation and packaging.
- High contamination: Large share of general waste, insulation or suspect items needing checks.

variants.name: Scrap metal
variants.description: For example steel offcuts, swarf, sheet, profiles. EWC 17 04 05, 17 04 07, 12 01 01.
variants.longDescription:
## Scrap metal
For example steel offcuts, swarf, sheet, profiles.

- EWC codes: 17 04 05, 17 04 07, 12 01 01
- Low contamination: Clean, sorted metal; one alloy family.
- Medium contamination: Mixed metals with some paint, plastic or wood attached.
- High contamination: Oily swarf, mixed with other waste, or attached non-metal components.

variants.name: Plastic film
variants.description: For example stretch wrap, shrink film, LDPE bags. EWC 15 01 02, 20 01 39.
variants.longDescription:
## Plastic film
For example stretch wrap, shrink film, LDPE bags.

- EWC codes: 15 01 02, 20 01 39
- Low contamination: Clear or natural LDPE film, dry, few labels.
- Medium contamination: Coloured or printed film, some tape and labels.
- High contamination: Food or soil residue, mixed plastics, wet.

variants.name: Organic / food waste
variants.description: For example canteen waste, spoiled product, food processing residues. EWC 20 01 08, 02 03 04, 02 02 03, 20 02 01.
variants.longDescription:
## Organic / food waste
For example canteen waste, spoiled product, food processing residues.

- EWC codes: 20 01 08, 02 03 04, 02 02 03, 20 02 01
- Low contamination: Food only, unpackaged.
- Medium contamination: Some packaging, cutlery or compostable bags mixed in.
- High contamination: Heavily packaged product or mixed with general waste.

feat-contamination.name: Contamination
feat-contamination.question: How clean is the stream?
feat-contamination.description: How much other material is mixed in. Decides which routes are open.
feat-contamination.longDescription:
## Contamination
Graded low, medium or high against the material's own definitions.

variants.name: Low
variants.description: Clean and separated. Fits the material's best route.
variants.longDescription:
## Low contamination
Clean and separated. Fits the material's best route. Each material defines the level in its own terms.

variants.name: Medium
variants.description: Some other material mixed in. Recycling may carry a surcharge.
variants.longDescription:
## Medium contamination
Some other material mixed in. Recycling may carry a surcharge. Each material defines the level in its own terms.

variants.name: High
variants.description: Heavily mixed, wet or soiled. Some routes are closed.
variants.longDescription:
## High contamination
Heavily mixed, wet or soiled. Some routes are closed. Each material defines the level in its own terms.

mod-route.name: Treatment route
mod-route.question: Where should the waste go?
mod-route.description: Reuse, recycling, recovery or landfill: the EU waste hierarchy, circular first.
mod-route.longDescription:
## Treatment route
Only routes allowed for the stream and its contamination are open. The rules come from the WasteQuote eligibility table, generated into this model.

variants.name: Cardboard & paper: recycling (baled to paper mill)
variants.description: Recycling. Baled to paper mill, operation R3.
variants.longDescription:
## Recycling: Baled to paper mill
The material is reprocessed into new material: paper mill, steelworks, film regranulate, panel board, anaerobic digestion.

- Waste hierarchy: Recycling (circular)
- Operation code: R3
- Allowed at contamination: low, medium
- Gate fee: €0/t (indicative)
- Material rebate: €71/t at clean grade

Priced per tonne in WasteQuote from the estimated weight, so the list price here is 0.

variants.name: Cardboard & paper: recovery (energy from waste)
variants.description: Other recovery, e.g. energy recovery. Energy from waste, operation R1.
variants.longDescription:
## Recovery: Energy from waste
The material is burned for energy (energy from waste, biomass, refuse-derived fuel). The material itself is lost.

- Waste hierarchy: Other recovery, e.g. energy recovery
- Operation code: R1
- Allowed at contamination: medium, high
- Gate fee: €152.7/t (indicative)
- Incineration tax, R1 energy recovery (Catalonia): €15/t

Priced per tonne in WasteQuote from the estimated weight, so the list price here is 0.

variants.name: Cardboard & paper: landfill (non-hazardous landfill)
variants.description: Disposal. Non-hazardous landfill, operation D1.
variants.longDescription:
## Landfill: Non-hazardous landfill
Deposit in a non-hazardous landfill. Lowest in the hierarchy and taxed.

- Waste hierarchy: Disposal
- Operation code: D1
- Allowed at contamination: medium, high
- Gate fee: €40.3/t (indicative)
- Landfill tax (Catalonia 2026): €25/t

Priced per tonne in WasteQuote from the estimated weight, so the list price here is 0.
